body.purpose: Calm native reading, not terminal text

motion.name: document-open
motion.purpose: file-to-window continuity; disabled with reduced motion

extensions.launcher: search filenames/content and real actions; native dialog; keyboard endpoints; maximize/restore

narrative.overview: Amber application chrome surrounds a calm brown-black reading surface. Per-file session reading state and a full semantic no-JavaScript fallback preserve access without changing the OS identity.
keyCharacteristics: Original bitmap identity, readable native HTML prose.
Thin amber application strokes and divided controls.
Immediate file destinations; no boot or permission gate.
rules: Keep the flat amber shell and original bitmap identity.
Body paragraphs, endnotes, sidebar explanatory prose and identity supporting prose are at least 16px.
Keep per-file pane/page offsets on minimize, switch, Home, Escape and Back; discard only on Close or reload.
Mobile Home, window actions and Back remain reachable while reading.
No-JavaScript mode exposes the same four complete semantic documents and native LinkedIn action.
Texture changes home pixels even with reduced motion and never textures document text.
dos: Do keep meaningful document prose readable and untextured.
Do retain reachable Home, Back and app switching on mobile.
donts: Don't introduce fake diagnostics, irrelevant games or permission prompts.
Don't copy blackletter, OS logos, source assets or project claims.
